STEP 1 - Scene: A salad-and-flatbread style meal on a white square plate, photographed from a high angle at a slight tilt. The plate sits on a light surface with a dark rail at the top left. Visible food is a mound of mixed greens with a pizza-like or flatbread wedge at the lower left.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The plate is a square white plate roughly 22 cm across its longest undistorted side. Treating it as a ~22 cm square gives area ≈ 22 × 22 = 484 cm², though the plate is wider at the top than the visible rim suggests, so I use ~480 cm².

STEP 3 - Items:
- Mixed salad greens (lettuce/frisée-like leaves, dressed with a little seed/grain dressing)
- Flatbread or pizza-style wedge with cheese, tomato/red sauce, and a green pepper or jalapeño slice
- Cherry tomatoes (red, visible under the greens)
- Small amount of dark olive or bean pieces and diced orange vegetable

STEP 4 - Area:
- Mixed greens: ~35% of plate area (≈168 cm²)
- Flatbread wedge: ~10% (≈48 cm²)
- Cherry tomatoes: ~4% (≈19 cm²)
- Olives/other bits: ~2% (≈10 cm²)
Total covered ≈ 51% (≈245 cm²).

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Greens: 168 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 504 ml (loose, piled)
- Flatbread: 48 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 58 ml
- Tomatoes: 19 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 38 ml
- Olives/bits: 10 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 10 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Greens: 504 ml × 0.15 = 76 g
- Flatbread: 58 ml × 0.9 = 52 g
- Tomatoes: 38 ml × 0.6 = 23 g
- Olives/bits: 10 ml × 0.6 = 6 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Greens with dressing: 76 g × 25 kcal/100 g = 19 kcal
- Flatbread with cheese and sauce: 52 g × 260 kcal/100 g = 135 kcal
- Cherry tomatoes: 23 g × 18 kcal/100 g = 4 kcal
- Olives/bits: 6 g × 115 kcal/100 g = 7 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 157 g total and roughly 165 kcal is plausible for a modest salad with one flatbread wedge. The visible portion is partial, so this is an estimate.
